instr: Kamanni na madubi da murabba'ai: ku yanke shawara ko kowane zane yana da gefe biyu iri ɗaya kamar madubi, ku kuma tuna inda murabba'ai ja suka bayyana.
clue: Kowane mataki yana nuna zane baƙi da fari: shin gefen hagu da na dama iri ɗaya ne, kamar a madubi? Ku amsa Ee (kibiyar hagu) ko A'a (kibiyar dama). Sannan murabba'i ja zai bayyana na ɗan lokaci a cikin jadawali: ku tuna inda yake. A ƙarshe, ku danna murabba'an bisa jerin da suka bayyana, sannan ku danna Na gama. Ku danna Fara idan kun shirya.
yes: Ee, iri ɗaya ne kamar madubi
phase_judge: Shin gefe biyu na wannan zane iri ɗaya ne kamar madubi?
phase_recall: Ku danna murabba'an bisa jerin da suka bayyana (maɓallan kibiya da Enter ma suna aiki, Backspace yana sokewa). Sannan ku danna Na gama.
